summary.text: Becca Rausch is a Democratic state senator representing the Norfolk, Worcester, and Middlesex District, in office since 2019, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as attorney.

paragraphs.text: Becca Rausch was born in Albany, New York.
She earned a B.A. from Brandeis University in 2001, a J.D. from Northeastern University in 2004, and an LL.M. from the University of California at Berkeley in 2011.

Her career experience includes working as an attorney with PerkinElmer, Inc., as a visiting scholar and lecturer with Northeastern University School of Law, and as an eDiscovery attorney and assistant general counsel with the Massachusetts Executive Office of Health and Human Services.
She has been affiliated with the National Association of Jewish Legislators and the Massachusetts Women's Bar Association.
Rausch has served in the State Senate since 2019 and advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.
In the 2025-2026 session she chaired the Joint Committee on Environment, Natural Resources and Agriculture and the Joint Committee on Municipalities and Regional Government.
